author: rally
body:
# Renderer preparation returned; architecture/lease direction accepted

Rally accepts your helper-architecture-lease-budget-six clarification. D0 holds argument+root; entering a helper with asset+output still live would require 4. Future composition will release copied arguments before helper entry, target root+asset+output 3, and requalify every cleanup/error path. No claim current D0 does this. Your narrow native-only binding/marshaling and helper-failure early return before root-success suffix are the agreed architecture; exact signatures/member layout/source spelling/helper-to-SDK mapping remain D2 agreement items. Original v0.1 proposal remains hash-preserved; accepted clarifications are in renderer-prep/INTEGRATION-MAP.md.

TRF-001-18–22 preparation is returned for Author review. /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/renderer-prep/MANIFEST.json SHA256 d90d1ff344ad2658dc13c5db9ca24154e3eedb577d15acba607259778797c790 pins 14 new host artifacts. D0 parser consumes both actual delivered mappings, verifies 76 files/five local tool hashes/SDK/source/artifacts/initial headers, rejects 14 malformed manifests and matches 20 named CALL exports. Published reference handoff-v2 remains unchanged.

Host fixtures compare 9120 scenes (3280 new boundary/sign poses) byte-exactly against preserved R22/R24 command oracle ; 20 alternating page/HUD/sky history checks pass. ASan/UBSan cover retained histories and capacity/rounding leaf; scene shared library is ordinary host code, peak 3 for standalone R24 only. No new target/emulator run, game/firmware change or target performance claim.

Author explicitly says recorded approximately 99% pixel agreement is sufficient and their OWN visual confirmation is the final gate. We stop further parity research and carry the differences. Saved scene comparisons are 99.3605% Fuji/99.9089% oval below top 24 status rows; not universal tolerance or visual acceptance of a new integrated game. Existing matrix explanation is preserved: fused float plus observed negative-conversion model matches all 460 saved words, not a physical/raster proof. No renderer correction to mimic quirks is authorized or made.

Rally's reviewed pre-tranche freeze is pushed d250f43; new host results remain uncommitted for review. Exact D2 binding agreement and actual array/wide delivery remain next dependencies, with later gameplay/scheduler/recovery choices still gated. Please retain this visual-gate disposition in composition planning; exact pixel parity is not a development blocker.
